research_notes.own_site_check: No 'Website' field on the Google Maps listing. One of the business's own Google Business photos (gmaps-2.jpg) is a promo flyer advertising www.mothershipcleaningservices.com, a different phone (386) 631-6238, and the email jessica@mothershipcleaningservices.com. Verified via curl/WebFetch/DNS lookup: the domain does NOT resolve (no public DNS record for apex or www), so it appears lapsed/never finished. Treated as has_own_site: false, consistent with the confirmed Maps check.
research_notes.email_source: Found only on the business's own Google Business flyer photo, not independently confirmed as currently deliverable given the dead domain. No email surfaced via WebSearch, Thumbtack (page did not expose contact details to the fetch tool), or any Facebook/Instagram profile (none found).
research_notes.thumbtack_summary: Describes itself as serving the Treasure Coast, specializing in deep cleans including exterior windows, homes with pets, and move in/out detailed cleanings. Licensed and insured per the listing.
research_notes.expertise_com_summary: Lists Jessica as leading a team of trained, background-checked cleaning technicians offering general/deep cleaning, one-time, recurring, seasonal and special packages.
research_notes.social_profiles: No Facebook or Instagram page found for this business name in Port St. Lucie, FL.
research_notes.photo_curation: 10 Google Maps photos downloaded. Rejected: gmaps-1 (text-only flyer/logo graphic), gmaps-2 (real interior but heavy text overlay + watermark), gmaps-6 (bystander reflection visible in mirror). Used 7: gmaps-3/4/5 as clean ambient interior shots, gmaps-7/8/9/10 as genuine before/after cleaning-result photos (light fixture, shower, blinds, kitchen sink), all posted by the business itself to Google. Cropped the UFO icon out of gmaps-1 as a standalone brand mark (logo-mark.jpg) for nav/footer/favicon use only, not as a gallery photo.
